menu.title: Chicken Game
menu.story:
Kkoko the hen lived peacefully.
One day, a fearsome Golden Pig appeared
and kidnapped her precious chicks.
Defeat the pig and rescue them!

Move with arrows or WASD and attack with Space.
Hold Space for auto fire.

gameclear.story:
Kkoko defeated the Golden Pig
and successfully rescued the precious chicks.
Upon returning to the village,
she was welcomed as a hero.
With great courage and wise choices,
Kkoko saved the village
and will be remembered as its hero.

Your score: {{score}}

Thank you for playing.
